title: SSF Research Watch v0.1 — scientific evidence discovery, dedup and impact triage
question: Which authoritative sources and metadata (Crossref/DOI, arXiv, OpenAlex/ADS, preprint vs peer-reviewed status, retraction/correction records) should ground SSF's Research Watch so it can discover new scientific work, deduplicate by DOI/arXiv/registry, score relevance against the SSF/KG curriculum scope, and classify impact (NEW/CONFIRMS/REVISES/CONTRADICTS/DEPRECATES/NO_IMPACT/UNCERTAIN) without treating every publication as accepted knowledge?
why_now: Open auto-routed task EXT-ECO-SSF-20260821-001 (2026-08-21) mandates the smallest useful Research Watch v0.1 with persistent evidence/discovery records, DOI/arXiv/registry deduplication, relevance scoring, impact classification and bounded promotion into RESEARCH_DISCOVERY/CANON_VALIDATION TaskCandidates. The Supabase schema has no evidence/discovery tables and no discovery adapter exists; SSF currently depends on manually introduced topics. The task explicitly affects SSF, KG and NOXIA and requires cross-project requests via KUEPER outbox envelopes.
